title: Lost Mary Maryliq Lime Rum 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Discover Maryliq: Lost Mary's iconic flavours as found in bestselling disposable vapes like the BM600, QM600 and AM600, are now available in 10ml nicotine salt e-liquids. Maryliq provides a discreet, yet richly flavoured vapour and a smooth throat hit, offering quick relief for your nicotine cravings. Available in 10mg & 20mg strengths, it's the ideal choice for recent quitters or those after immediate nicotine satisfaction. Unlike traditional high-PG freebase liquids, Maryliq's nic salts deliver a smoother throat hit and quicker nicotine absorption. Compatible with starter and pod vape kits, these 10ml bottles let you enjoy your favourite flavours longer than 2ml disposables, minimising plastic waste. Embark on a flavour journey to the tropics with Lost Mary Maryliq's Lime Rum. This unique e-liquid starts with the zesty pop of Lime, complemented by the warm, sweet notes of Vanilla and Brown Sugar. What sets it apart is the distinct undertone of Rum that adds an exotic twist to your vape experience. Ideal for those who enjoy a multi-layered, complex vape, Lime Rum brings the essence of a tropical cocktail into every puff. The 50% VG / 50% PG ratio is perfectly balanced for a smooth throat hit and a flavourful cloud, making it a perfect all-day vape.
